elaine_cs: Noting an issue reported 09:45 UTC: a subset of onboarding jobs are stuck in retry/backoff, causing duplicated provisioning attempts and delayed tenant activation. Customers report seeing a "pending" state for >30m.

tom_infra: looking. we see the retry queue flooded after a downstream webhook started returning 502s for ~12m; retry backoff logic mis-calculated next-delay leading to retry storms.

javier_eng: repro logs: job id jb-20260325-77c. stack: https://internal/logs/ob-77c (redacted). patch ready to clamp retry jitter and add circuit-breaker on webhook 5xx.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-20260325-03 1 Retry storm causing onboarding delays. Bridge: https://bridge/INC-20260325-03

marta_support: collecting impacted accounts now. priority: active trials with upcoming renewals and any enterprise onboardings. uploading CSV when ready.

elaine_cs: drafted outbound note — brief + enterprise variant. sharing for review:
```
Hi <customer>,
We're investigating delays affecting tenant activation and onboarding retries between 09:409:58 UTC. Some provisioning attempts retried multiple times due to transient webhook 5xx responses, which caused duplicate attempts and slower activation. No action required. We're fixing retry logic and will follow up with a timeline and credit info by EOD.
```

priya_pm: propose credits: trials = extra 2 trial days, paid = 2% invoice credit if activation delayed >1h, enterprise = 1:1 onboarding session + credit as needed. finance ok?

marta_support: sending trial/paying lists: https://drive/impacted-onboard-20260325.csv. will add enterprise contacts separately.

tom_infra: patch deployed at 09:57 UTC (clamped backoff + webhook circuit). inflight retries down 95%. ETA to clear queue ~8m.

javier_eng: post-incident actions: add metric for retry storm, set circuit thresholds, and add a one-minute cooldown for repeated webhook 5xx. RCA owner = @javier_eng, mitigation owner = @tom_infra, comms = @elaine_cs.

elaine_cs: I'll send outbound to trials/paid at +15m with the template and coordinate enterprise calls. will include credit mechanics and next steps.

deploy-bot: Incident status: resolving 1 queue draining.

marta_support: thanks team. will monitor replies and escalate any hard-fail accounts.
